arguments:
set -euo pipefail
runtime="$(pwd -P)"
base="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martaxi-boss/VPS/8bc1687abafd125746caf546a343bdc229d01141/rea-linux/runtime"
mkdir -p "$runtime/docs"
for item in README.md OPERATIONS.md; do
    tmp="$(mktemp)"
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
    curl -fsSL --max-time 25 "$base/$item" -o "$tmp"
    case "$item" in
        README.md) expected="2d422c02220f8fed49c71a14abed4c342ced5e07" ;;
        OPERATIONS.md) expected="ec7fd5dde7365746ae71f63b205ca468fcdadc2b" ;;
    esac
    actual="$(git hash-object "$tmp")"
    test "$actual" = "$expected"
    install -m 644 "$tmp" "$runtime/docs/$item"
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT
    echo "REA_FINAL_LOCAL_DOC_$item=pass"
done
test -x "$runtime/bin/rea-mcp"
echo "REA_FINAL_PORTABLE_LOCAL_LAYOUT=pass"
